questions.question_text: In a globe-and-flashlight simulation, what planetary phenomenon causes the boundary between day and night (the circle of illumination)?
options: A) Earth's axial rotation exposing half the sphere to flashlight 'sunlight' while the opposite half remains in shadow.
B) The flashlight turning off automatically.
C) The globe melting under heat.
D) The Moon blocking all light.
questions.correct_answer: A) Earth's axial rotation exposing half the sphere to flashlight 'sunlight' while the opposite half remains in shadow.
questions.detailed_explanation:
HINT: Axial rotation exposes half of a spherical planet to light while the other half faces away.

DETAILED STEP-BY-STEP REASONING:
Earth is an opaque sphere. Sunlight illuminates the hemisphere facing the Sun (day), while the opposite hemisphere receives no light (night). Rotation shifts longitudes continuously across this boundary.

questions.question_text: Why do deciduous trees in North India shed their leaves during winter, whereas monsoon forests shed leaves during dry summer?
options: A) Trees shed leaves to reduce transpiration water loss during dry or freezing seasons when soil water absorption is restricted.
B) Trees shed leaves to catch flying birds.
C) Leaf shedding is caused by moonlight.
D) Trees shed leaves to turn into rocks.
questions.correct_answer: A) Trees shed leaves to reduce transpiration water loss during dry or freezing seasons when soil water absorption is restricted.
questions.detailed_explanation:
HINT: Leaf shedding (abscission) prevents moisture loss during dry/cold periods.

DETAILED STEP-BY-STEP REASONING:
Transpiration evaporates water through stomata. Dropping leaves during dry or freezing conditions conserves vital water inside plant stems.

questions.question_text: What is the main cause of changing seasons on Earth?
options: Distance between Earth and Sun changing
Earth rotating on its axis every 24 hours
Earth 23.5 degree axial tilt combined with its revolution around the Sun
Moon blocking sunlight during eclipes
questions.correct_answer: Earth 23.5 degree axial tilt combined with its revolution around the Sun
questions.detailed_explanation:
[HINT / CONCEPT KEY] Axial tilt alters direct sunlight intensity throughout the year.
[DETAILED STEP-BY-STEP REASONING] Earth constant 23.5 degree axial tilt causes different hemispheres to tilt toward or away from the Sun during its 365.25-day orbit.
[CORE TAKEAWAY] Rotation causes day/night; revolution + axial tilt causes seasons.
